recipes.name: Strawberry Cheesecake Overnight Oats
instructions: In a small bowl, microwave the strawberries on high for 1 to 2 minutes, until thawed*. Mash with a fork and let cool slightly.
In a medium bowl, combine the oats, milk, cashew butter, lemon juice, maple syrup, flaxseeds, and vanilla.
Spoon the thawed berry mixture into the bottom of a mason jar or airtight container, then spoon the oat mixture on top. Seal and refrigerate overnight.
The next morning, top with yogurt and any other desired toppings. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium . * Alternatively, the strawberries can be thawed on the stove.
Storage The oats can be stored in a mason jar or airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days.
